4600.name: On The Taiga

north.description: To the north lies On The Taiga.

east.description: To the east lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

4600.description:
A frozen stream winds through the taiga here, and the path crosses it on
a bridge of three spruce logs lashed together and worn smooth by many
feet. The forest is quiet but for the creak of branches under their
burden of snow. West lies a clearing with an old campfire ring, and the
woods continue north and east.

4601.name: On The Taiga

north.description: To the north lies On The Taiga.

east.description: To the east lies On The Taiga.

south.description: To the south lies On A Rocky Mountain Trail.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

4601.description:
Dark spruces stand close together here, their lower branches dead and
grey with beard lichen, and old snow lies in the hollows between their
roots. South, the trees thin toward a barren, rocky hillside, and a foul
goblin stench drifts from that way on the wind. Paths wind away through
the forest north, east and west, soft with fallen needles.

4602.name: On The Taiga

north.description: To the north lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

4602.description:
The taiga grows dense and dark here, the spruces so tightly packed that
little snow reaches the ground between them. A thick carpet of needles
muffles every sound, and the air smells sharply of resin. Claw marks
score the bark of one great trunk, high above a man's head. North, the
trees thin toward a windy pass between two peaks; west, the forest runs
on.

6602.name: On The Taiga
6602.description:
Dark spruce and larch draw back here from a small clearing at the edge
of the taiga, where the ground begins to climb toward the mountains
looming to the north. A ring of blackened stones marks an old campfire,
and a few logs have been dragged around it for seats, their bark rubbed
smooth. Snow lies in crusted drifts beneath the trees, trampled flat
around the fire. The forest runs on east and south, a sea of dark
needles under a low grey sky.

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies On The Taiga.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

6606.name: On The Taiga

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies On The Taiga.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

6606.description:
Tall spruces and a few white-barked birches grow here at the foot of the
mountains, whose grey slopes climb steeply to the north. West, a path
leads toward a broad clearing used by travellers as a resting place. The
forest continues east and south, quiet and dim beneath boughs heavy with
snow.

4605.name: On The Taiga

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Taiga.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

4605.description:
The spruce forest grows thinner and more stunted here, as if the trees
were shrinking from the cold that pours down from the open land to the
north. Beyond the last trunks the tundra stretches away, white and grey
and empty. East, the trees crowd toward the mouth of a narrow pass,
while the forest deepens south and west.

6612.name: On The Taiga
6612.description:
The taiga thins out here at its northern edge, the spruce shrinking to
stunted, wind-bent trees no taller than a man. Beyond them the open
tundra begins, a grey-brown waste of moss and frozen tussocks stretching
away north and east under a hard white sky. A thin rime of frost covers
the ground, printed with several sets of boot tracks that all look
recent. South and west the dark forest closes in again, its needles
hissing in the bitter wind.

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

4607.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Taiga.

4607.description:
Here the open tundra meets the mouth of a narrow pass that cuts west
between two towering peaks, and the wind howls out of it carrying
flurries of snow. The ground is bare and hard, swept clean by the
endless gale. The tundra stretches away north and east, and the pass
offers a little shelter among a few stunted spruces.

4608.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4608.description:
A shallow hollow on the tundra's edge holds a spring that never quite
freezes, steaming faintly in the bitter air and ringed with a crust of
yellow ice. The snow around it is criss-crossed by animal tracks of
every size, all leading to the water. Beyond the hollow the land rises
into rough, broken hills where no path goes. The way leads north and
west across the open tundra.

4609.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4609.description:
The forest gives out here, and the last few spruces stand alone on the
open ground, twisted and bare on their windward side like tattered
flags. Beyond them the tundra rolls away in low, snow-streaked swells of
moss and lichen. South lies the shelter of the taiga, west the land
climbs steeply into the mountains, and the open tundra stretches north
and east.

4610.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4610.description:
A thin carpet of grey-green reindeer moss covers the ground here,
crunching like dry biscuit underfoot. South, the tundra falls toward a
narrow pass between two towering peaks, where boot prints in the frost
lead up from the trees. The open land stretches north, east and west,
empty and silent but for the wind.

4611.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4611.description:
A thicket of dwarf willow grows in a shallow dip here, no higher than
your knee, its twisted branches knotted into a dense grey mat. The snow
around it is laced with the tracks of small creatures that shelter
beneath. Trails cross the dip in every direction, leading north, east,
south and west across the tundra.

4612.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4612.description:
The tundra rises in a long, gentle swell here, its crest crusted with
orange and black lichen and studded with frost-heaved stones standing on
end like teeth. The wind has carved the snow into hard ridges that
crunch and squeak underfoot. North, a ring of boulders crowns a nearby
rise, and the open ground runs on south and west.

4613.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4613.description:
A great fan of frost-shattered rock spills out from the mountains onto
the tundra here, its boulders cracked open and crusted with black
lichen. Snow has drifted deep behind each stone. West, a rough path
climbs onto the mountainside, while the open tundra runs north, east and
south beneath a heavy, leaden sky.

4614.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4614.description:
A small frozen lake lies in a hollow here, its surface swept clean by
the wind into a sheet of dark grey ice. Reeds poke stiffly through at
its margins, and the ice booms and groans as it settles. On still days
the lake mirrors the sky so perfectly that the horizon seems to vanish.
Paths skirt its shores to the north, east, south and west.

4615.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4615.description:
A cairn of stacked stones stands on a low hummock here, built roughly in
the shape of a man with outstretched arms, as if pointing the way across
the featureless white. Its stones are glazed with rime. East, a ring of
great boulders crowns a rise, and the tundra runs north, south and west
beneath a sky the colour of pewter.

extra_descs.cairn stones figure man:
The cairn's arms are two long, flat stones balanced across its
shoulders, one pointing toward the mountains and the other toward the
glacier. The hunters of this cold country build such figures to tell the
traveller that people have passed this way before.

6603.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

6603.description:
A ring of great boulders crowns a low rise here, forming a natural fort
with a commanding view across the tundra. Inside the ring the snow is
trampled to slush, a fire pit holds cold black ashes, and crude shelters
of hide and spruce boughs lean against the stones. Lookout perches have
been scraped flat atop the tallest boulders. Paths leave the ring north,
south and west.

4617.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4617.description:
A single enormous boulder squats on the open tundra here, a lump of pink
granite utterly unlike the grey rock of the mountains nearby, as though
some giant had let it fall. Its lee shelters a patch of bare ground
where moss and crowberry grow thick. The mountains rise close by to the
west, and the tundra stretches north, east and south.

4618.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4618.description:
The ground here is broken into a strange honeycomb of low polygons, each
ringed by a shallow crack where the frost has split the earth. Snow
fills the cracks, drawing a white net across the brown moss. Ways lead
north, east, south and west, and the pattern stretches away on every
side as if some vast hand had laid it out.

6605.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

6605.description:
A sheltered swale lies between two low rises here, and the wind has
swept much of the snow from its floor, uncovering pale grass and sedge.
The ground is pocked with the neat, split prints of deer and nibbled
patches where they have grazed. The tundra opens north, east, south and
west, and the swale's shelter makes the cold a little kinder.

4620.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4620.description:
A frozen bog fills a broad hollow here, its tussocks of cotton grass
standing up from the ice like the heads of drowned men. The ice between
them is thin and dark in places, and the smell of peat rises from
beneath it. Firmer ground skirts the bog to the north and south, and a
way leads west across the tundra.

4621.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

4621.description:
A frozen brook winds across the tundra here in a shallow channel, its
ice clouded white and humped with trapped bubbles. Under the ice, dark
water can still be seen moving slowly. Tufts of dead sedge rattle along
its banks in the bitter wind. Beyond the far bank the mountains wall off
the land, and the tundra opens north, east and south.

4622.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4622.description:
A long, low ridge of gravel snakes across the tundra here like the back
of some buried serpent, left by a river that ran beneath the ice in ages
past. Cotton grass grows along its flanks in tufts of white fluff that
shiver in the wind. The ridge makes a good path, and ways lead off
north, east, south and west.

6608.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

6608.description:
A strange round mound rises from the flat tundra here, a dome of earth
pushed up from beneath by ice, its sides split open by deep cracks. From
its top you can see for miles: the glacier's white wall, the dark smudge
of the taiga, and the mountains brooding over all. Ways lead north,
east, south and west.

6611.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

6611.description:
A weathered signpost leans drunkenly here, its paint flaked away and its
lettering barely legible, the only made thing in sight on the open
tundra. The ground around it is trampled, and the snow is marked by boot
prints coming and going. The tundra stretches north toward the glacier's
foot, south over low rises, and west across a shallow dip.

4625.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies The Icy Slope.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

4625.description:
This is a lonely corner of the tundra, hemmed in by the mountains' spurs
and the glacier's icy foot, where the wind circles and moans. A tall
pole of grey, weathered spruce stands planted in a pile of stones, hung
with strips of faded cloth that flutter in the gusts. North, the ground
climbs onto the icy slope, and east the tundra opens out again.

4626.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies The Icy Slope.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4626.description:
Snow lies in deep drifts here against a low ridge of rock, sculpted by
the wind into smooth curves and sharp-edged cornices. Walking is slow,
the crust breaking with every step and dropping you knee-deep. North,
the icy slope climbs toward the glacier, and the tundra runs east and
west along its foot.

4627.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies The Icy Slope.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4627.description:
The tundra tilts upward here into slopes glazed with ice, and above them
the blue-white face of a glacier fills the sky to the north like a
frozen wave. Cold air pours down off the ice in a steady, numbing wind
that smells of nothing at all. Gravel and broken ice crunch underfoot,
and ways lead east, west and south across the open ground.

4628.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies The Icy Slope.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4628.description:
The tundra rises here toward a dark gash in the glacier's face, and a
beaten path leads north up the icy slope toward it. The path is marked
with small posts of bleached bone, crude and unsettling. Elsewhere the
tundra lies open, stretching east, south and west in frozen swells of
moss and stone. Your breath smokes in the air and freezes on your
collar.

4629.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies The Icy Slope.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4629.description:
A chain of small frozen pools lies across the tundra here, fed by
meltwater from the glacier and frozen now into milky blue discs. The ice
slope climbs north toward the glacier's foot, and the wind that pours
down it carries needles of ice. Ways lead east, south and west over
hummocks of moss.

4630.name: On The Tundra

north.description: To the north lies The Icy Slope.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies On The Tundra.

4630.description:
Wind-scoured gravel covers the ground here, swept bare of snow and moss
alike, with only a few dwarf willows creeping flat among the stones. The
broken runners of an old sledge lie half buried in the gravel, bleached
grey by sun and frost. North rises the icy slope below the glacier, and
the tundra runs on south and west.

4631.name: The Icy Slope

east.description: To the east lies The Icy Slope.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

4631.description:
The icy slope steepens here beneath an overhanging cliff of glacier ice,
blue and translucent, hung with icicles longer than spears. Now and then
one breaks loose and shatters on the slope with a sound like breaking
glass. The slope runs on east along the glacier's foot, and south it
falls away to the tundra.

4632.name: The Icy Slope

east.description: To the east lies The Icy Slope.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies The Icy Slope.

4632.description:
The ground here is a steep apron of old ice and frozen gravel spilling
from the glacier's foot, and every step threatens to send you sliding.
The glacier towers overhead, its face streaked with grit and veined with
deep blue. Ways lead east and west across the slope, and south the ice
gives way to the open tundra below.

4633.name: The Icy Slope

north.description: To the north lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

east.description: To the east lies The Icy Slope.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies The Icy Slope.

4633.description:
A dark slit splits the face of the glacier here, a narrow crack running
north into the ice, its edges rounded and gleaming. The slope beneath it
has been worn into a rough path by many feet, the ice chipped into crude
steps. The icy slope runs on east and west, and south it falls away to
the tundra.

4634.name: The Icy Slope

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Tundra.

west.description: To the west lies The Icy Slope.

4634.description:
The icy slope levels out here into a broad sheet of wind-polished ice,
so smooth that it shines like a pewter plate under the clouds. Cracks
run through it like the lines on an old man's palm, and now and then one
of them gives a sharp report like a snapping branch. West, the slope
climbs toward the crack in the glacier, and the tundra lies open to the
east and south.

4635.name: The Narrow Crack In The Glacier

north.description: To the north lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

east.description: To the east lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

south.description: To the south lies The Icy Slope.

4635.description:
Walls of blue ice rise sheer on either side of this narrow crack, so
close that you could touch both at once, and far overhead runs a thin
seam of white sky. The light that filters through the ice is a deep,
cold blue, and the glacier creaks and groans constantly as it shifts.
The crack runs on north, a smaller fissure branches off east, and south
the way opens onto the icy slope.

4636.name: The Narrow Crack In The Glacier

south.description: To the south lies The Icy Slope.

west.description: To the west lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

4636.description:
This side fissure ends in a small hollow of ice, where meltwater has
frozen into curtains and pillars that glitter like glass. Somewhere deep
within the ice, water drips, each drop ringing like a tiny bell. The
fissure runs back west to the main crack, and a slippery chute leads
south out of the ice onto the open slope.

4637.name: The Narrow Crack In The Glacier

south.description: To the south lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

west.description: To the west lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

north.description: To the north lies Entrance to the Goblin Warrens.

4637.description:
The crack widens a little here, and its floor is churned into dirty
slush by many small, clawed feet. North, the ice gives out onto a bare
hillside where bone totems flank a jagged opening, and the stink of rot
and smoke from the Goblin Warrens drifts in on the wind. The crack runs
back south between its blue walls, and another branch winds west through
the ice.

4638.name: The Narrow Crack In The Glacier

north.description: To the north lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

east.description: To the east lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

west.description: To the west lies Edge of the Northern Forest.

4638.description:
The ice walls of the crack are lower here, and through a gap to the west
you can see dark ranks of pines and oaks marching away beneath a grey
sky, the edge of the Great Northern Forest. Wind-driven snow hisses
along the floor. The crack runs east between its glassy walls and turns
north, deeper into the glacier, where the ice rises higher and bluer.

6600.name: The Narrow Crack In The Glacier

north.description: To the north lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

south.description: To the south lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

east.description: To the east lies The Highland Trail.

6600.description:
The crack opens here into a small space in the ice where three ways
part, and a weathered signpost has been driven deep into the frozen
gravel. North, the crack runs on through the heart of the glacier toward
the Winterwood; east, the ice gives way to rocky, windswept ground
climbing into the Eastern Highlands. The way back south winds between
walls of creaking ice.

4641.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Valley.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

4641.description:
A rocky path climbs out of the forest here, leaving the trees behind for
slopes of scree and wind-stunted juniper. Blazes cut into the last
trunks mark the start of the trail. South, the path drops into the taiga
toward a clearing where travellers rest; north, it climbs into a
sheltered valley among the peaks. Another way runs east along the
mountainside.

4642.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies By The Cave Entrance.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4642.description:
A cliff rises sheer above this rocky slope, and at its foot, a short way
south, the black mouth of a cave yawns beneath an overhang. Large,
clawed prints lead in and out of it through the snow. Paths wander
north, east and west across the mountainside among boulders capped with
white.

4643.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies On The Taiga.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4643.description:
Here the mountains begin, rising from the dark edge of the taiga in
slopes of bare rock and scrubby juniper. South, the spruces close in
thickly; east, the open tundra rolls away under the wind. The path
climbs north along the mountain's flank, and a rougher track runs west
among the peaks.

4644.name: In The Valley

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Cabin.

4644.description:
A small, sheltered valley lies cupped among the peaks here, where the
wind drops and a little warmth lingers. A log cabin stands at its west
end, snug against the slope, with a stone chimney and a heavy plank
door. A woodpile is stacked high beneath its eaves, roofed with strips
of bark. Paths climb out of the valley north, east and south into the
mountains.

4645.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Valley.

4645.description:
Paths cross on a broad, stony shoulder among the peaks here, beside a
tall cairn that has begun to lean with the years. West, the land dips
into a sheltered valley where the roof of a log cabin shows among the
rocks. Other ways lead north toward a chasm, east toward a gully below
the summit, and south down a stony slope.

4646.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

up.description: To the up lies On The Mountaintop.

4646.description:
A steep gully climbs up from this rocky shoulder toward the summit of
the mountain, its floor packed with old ice and loose stones. The
shoulder itself is a meeting place of paths: north and south along the
mountain's flank, west into the heart of the peaks, and east down to a
fan of shattered rock on the tundra. The wind keens through the gully
like a voice.

4647.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Valley.

4647.description:
The path climbs out of the valley beside a frozen waterfall, a great
pillar of blue-white ice clinging to the cliff. Behind the ice, water
can still be heard trickling. Rime coats every rock and twig, thick as
fleece. East, the path runs across a high slope into the peaks; south,
it drops into the sheltered valley.

4648.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies The Ice Bridge.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4648.description:
The path comes to the brink of a deep chasm here, and a bridge of solid
ice arches north across the gulf, glittering and blue, the only way
over. Wind howls up out of the depths, carrying flakes of snow that
swirl upward instead of down. Paths lead east and south along the
mountainside, and west toward a frozen waterfall.

4649.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies On The Tundra.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4649.description:
The mountainside here looks out over the tundra, which stretches away
east in a vast pale plain to the glacier's foot. Frost-split boulders
lie strewn across a steep slope, and the path picks its way between
them. The wind tears at you from every side. South, the path follows the
mountain's flank; west, it climbs deeper into the peaks.

4650.name: By The Cave Entrance

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Cave.

4650.description:
Just inside the cave mouth, grey daylight still reaches the walls,
showing rough stone streaked with mineral stains in rust and green. The
floor is dry and dusty, strewn with dead leaves blown in from outside.
North, the entrance opens onto the snowy mountainside; east, the cave
runs back into darkness, and a musky smell drifts out of it.

4651.name: In The Cabin

east.description: To the east lies In The Valley.

4651.description:
The cabin is a single snug room of squared logs chinked with moss,
smelling of old smoke and pine resin. A fieldstone hearth fills one
wall, a bunk of lashed poles stands against another, and a plank table
and stool sit beneath a small shuttered window. The pegs by the door
hold nothing now, and dust lies thick on the sill. The door leads east,
out into the valley.

4652.name: On The Mountaintop

down.description: To the down lies In The Mountains.

4652.description:
You stand on the very summit of the mountain, a narrow crown of frost-
shattered rock with nothing above but the vast, pale sky. The whole of
the wild country lies spread below: the white sweep of the tundra, the
glacier gleaming like a frozen sea, and the dark forests beyond. A small
cairn marks the highest point, built by whoever first stood here. The
only way is back down the steep gully.

4653.name: The Ice Bridge

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

down.description: To the down lies The Bottom Of The Chasm.

4653.description:
You stand on a narrow span of ancient ice arching over a dizzying chasm,
its surface roughened by frozen grit and its edges sculpted into
delicate fringes. Beneath your feet the ice is clear enough to show the
dark depths below, and it creaks ominously with every step. The bridge
leads north and south to the mountainsides, and beside the span a
perilous line of ice-glazed ledges winds down into the chasm.

extra_descs.bridge ice span:
Deep inside the ice, like flies in amber, hang dark shapes: stones, a
broken spear shaft, the curve of something that might be a horn. The
bridge has been growing for a very long time.

4654.name: The Bottom Of The Chasm

north.description: To the north lies The Cave.

up.description: To the up lies The Ice Bridge.

4654.description:
The floor of the chasm is a jumble of ice-glazed boulders, and the walls
rise so high on either hand that the sky is only a pale stripe far
above, crossed by the thin, shining band of the ice bridge. It is
bitterly cold and utterly still. North, a dark cave opens at the foot of
the cliff, its mouth hung with icicles like teeth, and tufts of coarse
white hair cling to the rocks around it. Slick ledges climb back up
toward the bridge.

4655.name: The Cave

south.description: To the south lies The Bottom Of The Chasm.

4655.description:
The cave burrows deep into the chasm wall, its sides furred with frost
that glitters faintly in the grey light from the entrance. Deep gouges
score the icy floor, and a heap of cracked and gnawed bones fills one
corner. A rank, wild stench hangs in the still air, thick enough to
taste. The only way out is south, back into the chasm.

4656.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

up.description: To the up lies On The Ledge.

4656.description:
A torrent roars somewhere above, and its spray drifts down onto this
rocky shelf, freezing on every surface into a glaze of ice. A steep path
climbs up the cliff toward a ledge where the ancient arch of a stone
bridge can be glimpsed spanning the river. Other paths lead north up a
steep slope and east along the chasm's rim.

4657.name: In The Mountains

north.description: To the north lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies The Ice Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4657.description:
Beyond the ice bridge the path climbs onto a windswept ledge on the far
side of the chasm, scattered with boulders sheathed in rime. Looking
back south, the bridge gleams like a band of glass across the gulf. The
snow here lies deep and almost untrodden, save for a line of huge, heavy
footprints. The path continues north up the mountainside and west along
the chasm's rim.

6609.name: In The Mountains

east.description: To the east lies In The Mountains.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

6609.description:
The ridge ends at a knot of jagged rocks, frost-shattered into fantastic
spires and blades. In their shelter lies a small pocket of still air
where the snow has settled soft and smooth, and a few cushions of moss
show green where the rocks hold the sun's warmth. The ridge runs back
east, and a steep path drops south toward the sound of rushing water.

4659.name: In The Mountains

south.description: To the south lies In The Mountains.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mountains.

4659.description:
The path climbs to a high, bare ridge where the wind blows so hard that
you must lean into it to stay upright. Snow streams off the crest like
smoke. From here the land falls away on every side, a wilderness of
white peaks and grey valleys. The way runs south toward the ice bridge
and west along the ridge.

6610.name: On The Ledge
6610.description:
A shelf of grey rock juts from the mountainside here, barely wide enough
for two to stand abreast, with a dizzy drop beneath and the wind tearing
at your cloak. In the cliff to the north a stout wooden door is set into
a doorway cut from the living stone. Carved faces flank it on either
side, worn almost featureless by centuries of ice and wind. A narrow,
crumbling way leads down the rock toward the lower slopes.

north.description: To the north lies The Stone Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies In The Mountains.

extra_descs.faces carved carvings doorway:
The faces were once bearded and stern, perhaps dwarves or kings, but
frost has eaten away their features until only the hollows of eyes and
mouths remain. Someone has rubbed soot into one pair of eyes, so that it
seems to watch you.

6604.name: The Stone Hallway

south.description: To the south lies On The Ledge.

6604.description:
This long hallway has been hewn straight into the mountain, its walls
dressed smooth and carved with the same worn faces that peer from the
old bridge outside. Iron brackets for lamps line the walls, and stone
benches run along each side, polished by long use. The air is still and
noticeably warmer than out on the ledge. The only way out is south, back
toward the roar of the river.

4662.name: In The Cave

east.description: To the east lies In The Cave.

west.description: To the west lies By The Cave Entrance.

4662.description:
The cave narrows into a winding passage here, its walls close enough to
brush with both elbows and its ceiling lost in shadow. Tufts of coarse
black fur are caught on the jagged rock at shoulder height. Water drips
somewhere ahead, and the musky animal smell grows stronger. West, a
faint grey glow marks the entrance; east, the darkness deepens.

6601.name: In The Cave

west.description: To the west lies In The Cave.

down.description: To the down lies In A Large Cavern.

6601.description:
The passage opens into a round chamber whose floor is heaped with dry
leaves and moss dragged in to make a bed, and the walls are scored with
claw marks. In the middle of the floor a worn stone stair spirals down
into the deeps, but an ancient gate of black iron closes it fast, its
lock rusted solid and its bars wrought in graceful, leaf-like patterns.
The way out leads west.

extra_descs.gate bars iron stair:
The bars are wrought into twining leaves and slender, long-eared faces,
the work of no human smith. Far below the gate, a faint pale light seems
to come and go, as if someone carried a lamp through distant halls.

6607.name: On A Rocky Mountain Trail
6607.description:
The trail ends at a jagged crack in a barren hillside. Crude totems of
bone and feather flank the dark opening, and the stench of goblin
habitation is unmistakable. Scratch marks and old bloodstains mark the
rocks around the entrance. The forest lies safely to the south.

north.description: To the north lies On The Taiga.

south.description: To the south lies On A Moutain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Rocky Mountain Trail.

16101.name: On A Moutain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Rocky Mountain Trail.

up.description: To the up lies Up The Mountain.

16101.description:
The path clings to a steep mountainside of rain-dark rock, rising in
crooked switchbacks toward a cleft between two great walls of stone.
Mist drifts down from the heights, beading on the heather. North, the
path drops toward a barren hillside where crude totems of bone flank a
dark crack, and above, the way climbs on into the mist.

6613.name: Up The Mountain

up.description: To the up lies In Between Two Mountain Walls.

down.description: To the down lies On A Moutain Path.

6613.description:
The climb grows steep and wet here, a scramble over slabs of black rock
slick with mist, where tufts of coarse grass offer the only handholds.
Above, two sheer walls of dark stone rise close together, and the way up
leads between them into the gorge of Mount Ravenmist. Below, the path
winds back down the mountainside toward the wilderness. The wind brings
a smell of wet stone and old feathers down from the heights.

6600.name: timber wolf
6600.long_desc: A large timber wolf prowls through the undergrowth, watching you with yellow eyes.
6600.description:
This wolf is lean and powerful, with thick grey fur and intelligent yellow
eyes. It moves with the easy confidence of a predator in its own territory.

6601.name: black bear
6601.long_desc: A large black bear lumbers through the forest, sniffing the air.
6601.description:
This bear is massive, easily weighing several hundred pounds. Its thick
black fur is matted with burrs and its claws are as long as daggers.

6602.name: forest bandit
6602.long_desc: A rough-looking bandit lurks in the shadows, hand on sword.
6602.description:
This bandit wears mismatched leather armor and a dark cloak. A jagged
scar runs across one cheek, and his eyes dart nervously, sizing you up.

6603.name: bandit captain
6603.long_desc: A scarred bandit captain surveys his territory with cold eyes.
6603.description:
The captain of the forest bandits is a battle-hardened warrior wearing
well-maintained chainmail beneath his forest-green cloak. He carries a
fine longsword that was clearly stolen from someone of means.

6604.name: traveling merchant
6604.long_desc: A stout merchant rests by the roadside, guarding his pack.
6604.description:
This cheerful merchant carries an enormous pack stuffed with goods. He
seems to know these roads well and is happy to share directions with
travelers — for the price of a friendly ear.

6605.name: young deer
6605.long_desc: A young deer grazes peacefully among the wildflowers.
6605.description: A graceful young deer with soft brown eyes and spotted flanks.

606600.name: snow hare white
606600.long_desc: A white snow hare crouches in a hollow of the snow, its long ears twitching.
606600.description:
Its fur is pure white but for the black tips of its ears, and so thick
that it looks twice its true size. Its great hind feet are furred like
snowshoes, and its dark eyes bulge, watching for any movement. At the
first sign of danger it bolts away in great zigzag bounds.

606601.name: arctic fox white
606601.long_desc: An arctic fox trots across the snow, pausing now and then to listen with its head cocked.
606601.description:
Small and neat, it wears a thick coat of creamy white fur and a bushy
tail it curls around its face when it sleeps. Its short ears and blunt
muzzle are made for the cold, and its eyes are sharp and golden. It
listens to the snow, then pounces nose-first on whatever it hears
scurrying beneath.

606602.name: frost wolf grey silver
606602.long_desc: A frost wolf lopes through the snow, its pale eyes fixed hungrily on you.
606602.description:
A big, rangy wolf with a coat of grey and silver that fades to white
along its belly, its fur rimed with ice crystals that glitter as it
moves. Its breath smokes between bared yellow fangs. It is seldom alone;
somewhere nearby, the rest of its pack is surely watching.

606603.name: yeti ape snow beast white
606603.long_desc: A hulking yeti, white-furred like a great snow ape, rises from its haunches with a rumbling growl.
606603.description:
It stands half again as tall as a man, a great ape-like beast covered in
long, matted white fur stained yellow about the mouth and hands. Its
face is bare, grey-black and creased like old leather, with deep-set,
red-rimmed eyes beneath a heavy brow. Its arms hang nearly to the
ground, and one huge hand grips a long shard of sharpened bone.

6600.name: wolf pelt
6600.description: A thick grey wolf pelt, soft and well-furred.

706600.name: pick ice bone ice-pick
706600.room_desc: A long ice-pick of yellowed bone lies here, its point glinting with frost.
706600.description: A great thighbone, split and ground to a cruel point at one end and bound with braided sinew at the other for a grip. Yeti use such picks to hack footholds in the ice and to crack frozen carcasses, and it serves just as well against a living foe.

706601.name: pelt yeti white fur
706601.room_desc: A great shaggy white pelt lies here in a heap, reeking faintly of musk.
706601.description: The whole hide of a yeti, its long white fur so dense that no wind can pass through it. Worn about the shoulders it hangs nearly to the ground, heavy and warm as a hearthside, though the musky smell never quite fades.
